paper: Exact Transfer of Bounded Linear Recovery and Relative Weight Hierarchies

claims.statement: The helper kernel is contained in the helper code associated with the target-message space; the restricted helper map has image equal to the recoverable target-message space, is surjective onto that space, and has the stated kernel.
The minimum helper-union size for a rank-t internally realizable demand equals the t-th relative generalized Hamming weight of the associated nested code pair.
The eventual rank-t nonconfinement helper threshold is the t-th relative generalized Hamming weight plus the inner dual distance.
Minimizing the rank-t helper cost over target sets of size t gives the t-th generalized Hamming weight of the dual code minus t.
Outer families satisfying the stated primal and dual asymptotic hypotheses copy every bounded recovery equation onto the designated positive-density target classes.
Exact transfer of inclusion-minimal helper supports preserves the bounded reliability law and bounded service-rate region.
The projective-simplex family has the displayed relative-weight staircase, confinement thresholds, and rank-stratified reliability law.
